messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV: P0 — Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for /v1/generate across gateway G-1. Customers reporting errors. Alerting team: oncall.

annie_oncall: Oncall Annie here, I’m taking this. Acknowledge pager. Can someone post initial impact numbers and a few correlation IDs?

josh_sre: Saw a spike ~08:02 UTC. 5xx rate from gateway up from ~0.8% -> ~12% in 5m window. Putting quick hypothesis: upstream model-serving pool returning 502/504 under retry pressure. Need request logs and any recent deploys.

lee_runtime: No deploys in last hour. Pushing link to request dumps for last 20m: https://logs.internal/redwood/ingress/3302109876 (access: eng-sre, runtime). Sample Correlation IDs: corr=9d7f2a, corr=1c3b44, corr=7f5aa1.

maya_support: Customer impact — CS dashboard shows 18 orgs with >5% failure rate, 24k requests failed in last 15m, top affected route /v1/generate (mostly lower context lengths). Notifying top 3 customers now.

annie_oncall: Thanks. @josh_sre @lee_runtime prioritize gathering full request traces and any upstream proxy logs. If someone can paste a failing request trace snippet that includes response codes and retry headers that helps.

josh_sre: Copying a trimmed request log for corr=9d7f2a:

```
time=2026-01-24T08:02:13Z level=warn req_id=9d7f2a path=/v1/generate backend=engine-a status=502 msg="upstream connection reset" retries=2 latency_ms=312
time=2026-01-24T08:02:13Z level=info req_id=9d7f2a gateway_retry header=X-Retry-Count:2
```

lee_runtime: Another sample corr=1c3b44 shows upstream returning 504 after long queue:```
time=2026-01-24T08:03:01Z level=warn req_id=1c3b44 backend=engine-b status=504 queue_ms=4123 attempts=1
time=2026-01-24T08:03:01Z level=debug req_id=1c3b44 kv_cache_hit=false model_variant=ggml-v2
```

nora_product: Noting that traffic shifted to smaller context runs around 07:50 — could change kernel selection and pressure. Worth flagging for model infra.

josh_sre: Hypothesis 1: Engine pool saturation -> connection resets + long queue -> gateway retries amplify requests -> transient 5xx storm. Hypothesis 2: A specific engine variant misbehaving (engine-b) causing disproportionate errors.

annie_oncall: Mitigations to consider now: 1) reduce gateway client retry to 0 for this route, 2) route a portion of traffic to fallback engine variant (engine-c), 3) temporarily raise request timeout to avoid partial retries that hold queues. Which is quickest?

lee_runtime: Quickest: patch gateway routing to disable client-side retries for /v1/generate (one-line config) and route 20% traffic to engine-c. Command to apply route split (prod infra CLI): `infractl traffic-split set --service=ingress-gw --route=/v1/generate --split="engine-c:20,engine-a:40,engine-b:40"`

annie_oncall: Go ahead with disabling retries first, then split. @josh_sre please monitor error rate after each step.

josh_sre: Disabling retries now. Applied `gateway.config.retries.client=0` on G-1. Watching metrics.

(2m pass)

josh_sre: Error rate down from 12% -> 6.5% after disabling retries, P50 latency slightly improved. Still seeing some 502s from engine-b. Proceeding with route split to engine-c now.

lee_runtime: Route split applied. Command result: success.

(1m pass)

josh_sre: Error rate now 2.1% — dropping. Customer-facing errors decreasing. Continuing to collect full traces for RCA. Early signal: amplification from retries was major contributor.

maya_support: Notifying affected customers: initial mitigation reduces errors for most. CS will send follow-up notes.

annie_oncall: Good. For RCA we need: - full set of correlation IDs for failed requests (I’ll pull 15m window), - engine-side logs for engine-b around 07:45–08:10, - queue/worker metrics, - any autoscaler events. @lee_runtime can you pull engine-b logs and worker queue lengths?

lee_runtime: Pulling engine-b logs now and uploading to dropbox: https://drop.internal/tracepacks/3302109876-engine-b. Worker queue spikes are visible: backlog went from ~30 -> ~520 at 07:59. Autoscaler didn't scale fast enough (min replicas locked). Posting quick snippet:```
2026-01-24T07:59:12Z engine-b worker=12 queued=512 cpu=89% mem=71% error=connection_reset
2026-01-24T07:59:13Z engine-b worker=3 queued=498 cpu=92% mem=74% error=timeout
```

josh_sre: That backs hypothesis 1. Autoscaler config note: engine-b has min_replicas=2 cap in namespace override from recent experiment. We should check who changed that. @nora_product any recent perf experiments?

nora_product: Yes — we tested a low-min replica setting for cost experiment last week for engine-b. It was supposed to be reverted but looks like the revert didn't apply in prod. I’ll own the rollback and post the PR.

dan_cs: For handoff: I’ll take next shift monitoring and collect all artifacts for full RCA doc. Please flag anything that needs follow-up (SLO blips, customer callbacks).

annie_oncall: Thanks @dan_cs. Next steps checklist in thread: 1) collect full corrid list and attach to incident ticket, 2) escalate autoscaler config rollback and ensure scaling policy updated, 3) run a replay test against engine-b in staging with load to reproduce, 4) postmortem timeline writeup.

josh_sre: Adding a short timeline here: 07:45 — small uptick, 07:59 — queue spike on engine-b, 08:02 — gateway 5xx amplification observed, 08:05 — disabled client retries, 08:07 — traffic split to engine-c, 08:09 — errors drop below 3%.

annie_oncall: Handoff: I’m pausing oncall and handing to @dan_cs at 08:25 UTC. If anything regresses ping `#pager-emergency`. Closing live mitigation segment; continuing RCA gathering.

dan_cs: Taking over. I’ll assemble traces and coordinate post-incident writeup. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident (3302109876) status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline and artifacts: https://incidents.internal/3302109876 (do not edit).
